# Shopwise Fashion Edit

Shopwise is a fictional ecommerce demo containing five complete Amazon Fashion
catalog records. All public pages are accessible without authentication.

## Entry points

- Storefront: /shop
- Editable browsing journey: /shop/journey
- Machine-readable catalog: /shop/catalog.json
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## Product routes

Each product uses an Amazon-style route:

    /shop/dp/{parent_asin}

Product pages include semantic headings, product details, prices, ratings,
features, image alt text, and Product JSON-LD. The journey editor stores its
ordered ASIN sequence in the shareable `path` query parameter.

This is a demo. Cart and checkout actions do not process real orders.
